premise: After a long swim Seal flops onto the warm rocks; Gull asks why she isn't swimming, and soon everyone is resting in the sun with her.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Wind and the Sun' turned around: nobody has to be persuaded, the warm sun simply wins everyone over.
lesson: Rest is good for you too.
learning: Seals climb out onto rocks to rest and warm up in the sun.

en-US.title: Seal Warms Up
en-US.text: {seal:enter by swim} {seal:go to sea by swim} Seal was swimming in the cool blue sea, swish, swish, swish. {seal:face happy} After a long swim, she {seal:go to rocks} flopped out onto the rocks, {sfx:flop} splosh, {canvas:sunshine 0.7 35s} right into the sunshine. [sighs] {seal:live sleep hold} Ahhh. [short pause] {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Gull came flapping down beside her. {seagull:live squawk} Gull squawked. [curious] Why are you lying about on the rocks, Seal? The sea is for swimming! {seal:live sleep resume} [warmly] Swimming makes me chilly, said Seal. {seal:face happy} So seals climb out to rest, and warm up in the sun. Try it! {seagull:face surprised} {seagull:wobble} Gull tried it. Oh! It WAS warm. {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pelican came gliding down too, {pelican:face happy} and spread out his big white wings. [softly] {seal:live clap} Seal gave a happy little clap. {seagull:live sleep hold} {pelican:live sleep hold} [whispers] And for a while, the rocks were the quietest, warmest, sleepiest place of all. {seal:hearts}

es-ES.title: Foca entra en calor
es-ES.text: {seal:enter by swim} {seal:go to sea by swim} Foca nadaba por el mar azul y fresquito, fis, fis, fis. {seal:face happy} Después de nadar un buen rato, {seal:go to rocks} subió a las rocas de un salto, {sfx:flop} ¡chof!, {canvas:sunshine 0.7 35s} justo al sol. [sighs] {seal:live sleep hold} Aaah. [short pause] {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Gaviota bajó aleteando a su lado. {seagull:live squawk} Gaviota graznó. [curious] ¿Qué haces tumbada en las rocas, Foca? ¡El mar es para nadar! {seal:live sleep resume} [warmly] Nadar me da fresquito, dijo Foca. {seal:face happy} Por eso las focas salen a descansar y a calentarse al sol. ¡Pruébalo! {seagull:face surprised} {seagull:wobble} Gaviota lo probó. ¡Anda! Se estaba calentito DE VERDAD. {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pelícano bajó planeando también, {pelican:face happy} y extendió sus grandes alas blancas. [softly] {seal:live clap} Foca dio una palmadita feliz. {seagull:live sleep hold} {pelican:live sleep hold} [whispers] Y durante un rato, las rocas fueron el sitio más tranquilo, calentito y dormilón de todos. {seal:hearts}

ja-JP.title: アザラシさんの ひなたぼっこ
ja-JP.text: {seal:enter by swim}{seal:go to sea by swim}アザラシさんが、つめたくて青い海を、すいすいすい。{seal:face happy}たくさんおよいだら、{seal:go to rocks}岩の上へ、よいしょっと、{sfx:flop}べたーん。{canvas:sunshine 0.7 35s}おひさまの、ど真ん中です。[sighs]{seal:live sleep hold}ふうー。[short pause]{seagull:enter}{seagull:go to rocks}カモメさんが、そのとなりにまいおりてきました。{seagull:live squawk}クワッ、クワッ！[curious]「アザラシさん、どうして岩の上で、ごろごろしてるの？海は、およぐところでしょ！」 {seal:live sleep resume}[warmly]「およぐと、からだがひえちゃうの」 とアザラシさん。{seal:face happy}「だからアザラシは、岩にあがってひと休み。おひさまで、ぽかぽかあたたまるのよ。やってごらん！」 {seagull:face surprised}{seagull:wobble}カモメさんも、やってみました。あら！ほんとうに、ぽかぽか！{pelican:enter}{pelican:go to rocks}ペリカンくんも、すーっとまいおりて、{pelican:face happy}大きな白いはねを、ひろげました。[softly]{seal:live clap}アザラシさんは、うれしくて、ぱちぱち。{seagull:live sleep hold}{pelican:live sleep hold}[whispers]しばらくのあいだ、岩の上は、いちばんしずかで、ぽかぽかで、ねむたいばしょになりました。{seal:hearts}

de-DE.title: Die Robbe wärmt sich auf
de-DE.text: {seal:enter by swim} {seal:go to sea by swim} Die Robbe schwamm im kühlen blauen Meer, wusch, wusch, wusch. {seal:face happy} Nach einer langen Runde {seal:go to rocks} robbte sie hinaus auf die Felsen, {sfx:flop} platsch, {canvas:sunshine 0.7 35s} mitten in den Sonnenschein. [sighs] {seal:live sleep hold} Aaah. [short pause] {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Die Möwe kam neben ihr heruntergeflattert. {seagull:live squawk} Die Möwe kreischte. [curious] „Warum liegst du denn auf den Felsen herum, Robbe? Das Meer ist doch zum Schwimmen da!“ {seal:live sleep resume} [warmly] „Vom Schwimmen wird mir ein bisschen kalt“, sagte die Robbe. {seal:face happy} „Darum klettern Robben heraus, ruhen sich aus und wärmen sich in der Sonne. Probier's mal!“ {seagull:face surprised} {seagull:wobble} Die Möwe probierte es. Oh! Es WAR warm. {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Der Pelikan kam auch heruntergeschwebt {pelican:face happy} und breitete seine großen weißen Flügel aus. [softly] {seal:live clap} Die Robbe klatschte leise und zufrieden in die Flossen. {seagull:live sleep hold} {pelican:live sleep hold} [whispers] Und eine ganze Weile waren die Felsen das stillste, wärmste, schläfrigste Plätzchen weit und breit. {seal:hearts}

fr-FR.title: Phoque se réchauffe
fr-FR.text: {seal:enter by swim} {seal:go to sea by swim} Phoque nageait dans la mer bleue et fraîche, fliou, fliou, fliou. {seal:face happy} Après une longue baignade, il {seal:go to rocks} s’est hissé sur les rochers, {sfx:flop} flop, {canvas:sunshine 0.7 35s} en plein soleil. [sighs] {seal:live sleep hold} Ahhh. [short pause] {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Mouette s’est posée à côté de lui en battant des ailes. {seagull:live squawk} Elle a crié. [curious] « Pourquoi tu restes allongé sur les rochers, Phoque ? La mer, c’est fait pour nager ! » {seal:live sleep resume} [warmly] « Quand je nage longtemps, j’ai un peu froid, a dit Phoque. {seal:face happy} Alors les phoques sortent de l’eau pour se reposer, et pour se réchauffer au soleil. Essaie, tu verras ! » {seagull:face surprised} {seagull:wobble} Mouette a essayé. Oh ! C’était VRAIMENT tout chaud. {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pélican est descendu en planant, lui aussi, {pelican:face happy} et il a étalé ses grandes ailes blanches. [softly] {seal:live clap} Phoque a tapé des nageoires, tout content. {seagull:live sleep hold} {pelican:live sleep hold} [whispers] Et pendant un moment, les rochers ont été l’endroit le plus calme, le plus chaud et le plus endormi du monde. {seal:hearts}

it-IT.title: Foca si scalda al sole
it-IT.text: {seal:enter by swim} {seal:go to sea by swim} Foca nuotava nel mare blu e fresco, sciuf, sciuf, sciuf. {seal:face happy} Dopo una lunga nuotata, {seal:go to rocks} si è issata sugli scogli, {sfx:flop} flop, {canvas:sunshine 0.7 35s} proprio al sole. [sighs] {seal:live sleep hold} Aaah. [short pause] {seagull:enter} {seagull:go to rocks} Gabbiano è sceso svolazzando accanto a lei. {seagull:live squawk} Ha strillato: [curious] «Perché te ne stai sdraiata sugli scogli, Foca? Il mare è fatto per nuotare!» {seal:live sleep resume} [warmly] «Nuotare mi fa venire freddino», ha detto Foca. {seal:face happy} «Per questo le foche escono a riposare, e si scaldano al sole. Prova anche tu!» {seagull:face surprised} {seagull:wobble} Gabbiano ha provato. Oh! Che CALDUCCIO! {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pellicano è arrivato planando anche lui, {pelican:face happy} e ha aperto le sue grandi ali bianche. [softly] {seal:live clap} Foca ha fatto un piccolo applauso felice. {seagull:live sleep hold} {pelican:live sleep hold} [whispers] E per un po', gli scogli sono stati il posto più tranquillo, più caldo e più sonnacchioso di tutti. {seal:hearts}

zh-TW.title: 海豹曬太陽
zh-TW.text: {seal:enter by swim}{seal:go to sea by swim}海豹在涼涼的藍色大海裡游泳，咻、咻、咻。{seal:face happy}游了好久好久，牠{seal:go to rocks}一扭一扭爬上岩石，{sfx:flop}啪噠！{canvas:sunshine 0.7 35s}正好躺在陽光下。[sighs]{seal:live sleep hold}啊——好舒服。[short pause]{seagull:enter}{seagull:go to rocks}海鷗拍著翅膀，飛下來停在牠旁邊。{seagull:live squawk}海鷗大叫一聲。[curious]「海豹，你怎麼躺在岩石上？大海是用來游泳的呀！」 {seal:live sleep resume}[warmly]「游泳游久了，身體會冷冷的，」 海豹說。{seal:face happy}「所以我們海豹會爬上來休息，曬曬太陽，暖和一下。你也試試看！」 {seagull:face surprised}{seagull:wobble}海鷗試了一下。哇！真的好暖和！{pelican:enter}{pelican:go to rocks}鵜鶘也滑翔下來，{pelican:face happy}張開牠那對白白的大翅膀。[softly]{seal:live clap}海豹開心地拍拍鰭，啪、啪。{seagull:live sleep hold}{pelican:live sleep hold}[whispers]有好一會兒，這片岩石成了最安靜、最暖和、最好睡的地方。{seal:hearts}

zh-HK.title: 海豹曬太陽
zh-HK.text: {seal:enter by swim}{seal:go to sea by swim}海豹在清涼的藍色大海裏游來游去，嗖、嗖、嗖。{seal:face happy}游了好久，牠{seal:go to rocks}一扭一扭地爬上岩石，{sfx:flop}啪嗒！{canvas:sunshine 0.7 35s}正好躺在陽光下。[sighs]{seal:live sleep hold}啊——好舒服。[short pause]{seagull:enter}{seagull:go to rocks}海鷗拍着翅膀飛下來，落在牠旁邊。{seagull:live squawk}海鷗呀呀叫。[curious]「海豹，你做乜瞓喺岩石度呀？大海係用嚟游水㗎！」 {seal:live sleep resume}[warmly]「游水游得耐，會凍㗎，」 海豹說。{seal:face happy}「所以我哋海豹會爬上嚟休息，曬吓太陽，暖返個身。你試吓啦！」 {seagull:face surprised}{seagull:wobble}海鷗試了一試。哇！真的好暖！{pelican:enter}{pelican:go to rocks}鵜鶘也滑翔下來，{pelican:face happy}張開又大又白的翅膀。[softly]{seal:live clap}海豹開心地輕輕拍了拍鰭。{seagull:live sleep hold}{pelican:live sleep hold}[whispers]有好一陣子，岩石上成了最安靜、最溫暖、最好睡的地方。{seal:hearts}

flop.prompt: a seal flopping out of the water onto a wet rock, a wet splash and slap, realistic
